mapper.select: SELECT group_id, receiver_id, feed_id, notification_type, actor_count, status, created_at, completed_at FROM notification_group_tbl WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND notification_type = #{notificationType} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY group_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_group_tbl ( receiver_id, feed_id, notification_type, actor_count, status ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{feedId}, #{notificationType}, 0, 'WAITING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_group_tbl SET actor_count = actor_count - 1 WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND actor_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM notification_group_actor_tbl WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_group_tbl SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
